Advocate Ehsanul Haque Shomaji

Criminal Law Practitioner and Consultant • Former Government Prosecutorial Adviser
Head of Chambers, Shomaji & Associates • Advocate, Supreme Court of Bangladesh

Mr. Shomaji devoted his professional career to criminal law practice, prosecution leadership, anti-corruption enforcement, and legal consultancy. He also contributed to legal education and national level policy reform initiatives. Through his long-standing service in Bangladesh’s justice sector, he has acquired specialized knowledge and skills in criminal litigation, prosecution strategy, evidence law, compliance advisory, and institutional legal reform.

1. Professional Summary

He is a senior criminal law practitioner and consultant with extensive courtroom and prosecutorial experience spanning multiple decades. He is the founder and Head of Chambers of Shomaji & Associates, one of the recognized law chambers in Dhaka, Bangladesh, where 23 advocates work under his leadership.

He has served the Government of Bangladesh in key prosecutorial positions, including:

  • Special Prosecutorial Adviser, Bangladesh Home Ministry (Status Equivalent to Attorney General) (December 2024 – February 2026)
  • Metropolitan Public Prosecutor, Dhaka (Caretaker Government Period)
  • Public Prosecutor, Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC), Bangladesh (source, source)

He has built expertise in digital and criminal investigation, evidence law, and financial crime enforcement through sustained engagement with programs supported by the U.S. Embassy. He participated in an Executive Seminar on Digital Investigation and a Department of Justice OPDAT Roundtable on the admission of digital evidence, both organized by the U.S. Embassy, as well as a Criminal Investigation seminar at Eastern University. He was also nominated for a workshop on strengthening enforcement and prosecution networks to combat illicit sanctions evasion, supported by the U.S. Embassy Dhaka (source). In addition, he was appointed by the U.S. Embassy Dhaka to review and edit a judicial bench book on money laundering laws for Bangladesh and was invited as a guest to its official launch, reflecting his contributions to judicial capacity building and legal resource development (source, source). He was also invited to be enlisted in the list of attorneys curated by the US Embassy to provide legal assistance to US citizens in Bangladesh (source).

Furthermore, He served as National Consultant (CrPC) for UNDP Bangladesh (2011). My professional contributions include conducting and supervising high profile criminal cases, advising prosecution networks, reviewing investigation materials, supporting legal reform efforts, and advising major corporate organizations on criminal risk management and compliance issues.

1. Educational Qualifications and Legal Training

He obtained his foundational legal education from the University of Dhaka, the leading academic institution of Bangladesh.

  • LL. B (Honors), University of Dhaka – 1984
  • LL.M, University of Dhaka – 1985

This academic training equipped him with comprehensive expertise in criminal law, constitutional law, criminal procedure, evidence law, legal ethics, and advocacy principles, which later became central to his specialization.

1. Bar Enrollment and Supreme Court Practice Authorization

He was formally enrolled as an advocate on 30 October 1986 and obtained membership of the Dhaka Bar Association on 04 November 1986.

He received authorization to plead before the Hon’ble High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh on 07 April 1988. Subsequently, He became a member of the Supreme Court Bar Association on 21 January 1992.

These milestones reflect his long-standing recognition as a qualified legal professional authorized to conduct litigation at the highest level of Bangladesh’s judiciary.

1. Career Focus and Major Legal Contributions in Criminal Litigation in Bangladesh

Throughout professional career, he has handled a significant number of criminal cases across Bangladesh. Many of these matters were considered high-profile and nationally significant due to their complexity and public impact.

His work has involved representation in cases related to:

  • Anti-corruption and public accountability
  • Financial fraud and corporate crime
  • Criminal conspiracy and organized misconduct
  • Regulatory violations and criminal compliance matters
  • Digital evidence and modern investigation-related litigation

Over time, he achieved national recognition as a specialized criminal law practitioner. His consistent involvement in complex litigation strengthened his reputation for effective trial advocacy, strategic prosecution handling, and legal interpretation of evidence law.

1. Government Prosecutorial Leadership and National-Level Service

• Metropolitan Public Prosecutor, Metropolitan Sessions Court, Dhaka (2007-2009) He was appointed as Metropolitan Public Prosecutor, Dhaka, and joined on 13 May 2007, during the caretaker government period. In this role, he represented the State and prosecution authorities in criminal matters before the relevant courts. He conducted numerous major criminal cases and supervised prosecution strategies in cases that were often treated as high profile or sensational.

• Public Prosecutor, Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC), Bangladesh (2007-2009) In June 2007, He joined as Public Prosecutor for the Anticorruption Commission (ACC), Bangladesh. He continued in this role until January 2009. During his tenure, he represented the ACC and State in major anticorruption cases against former political leaders, ministers and member of parliaments and contributed to strengthening prosecution capacity against corruption and financial crime.

• Special Prosecutorial Adviser, Bangladesh Home Ministry (2024 to 2026) Most recently, he served as Special Prosecutorial Adviser to the Bangladesh Home Ministry, with a status equivalent to the Attorney General for Bangladesh, from December 2024 to February 2026 (source, source). This role involved high level advisory responsibilities in criminal prosecution and institutional coordination. He was engaged in reviewing case materials, providing strategic legal opinions, and assisting in prosecution planning on behalf of the state. This appointment reflects his professional integrity, national level trust, and leadership role in the justice sector. During this period the Government also assigned him to assist in the investigation and trial of the murder of Inqilab Moncho spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi (source). During this period, he was also assigned as a special attorney in favor of the prosecution of rape and murder of the eight-year-old girl which led to death sentencing of 44-year-old Hitu Sheikh (source).

Beyond courtroom litigation, he have contributed directly to criminal justice administration through participation in meetings and consultations with national institutions including Police Headquarters, Dhaka Metropolitan Police Headquarters, Police Bureau of Investigation, Anti-termism unit, Detective Branch, Criminal Investigation Department (CID) under Bangladesh Police and the Ministry of Home Affairs.

His responsibilities included examining vetting police reports, and providing necessary legal opinions on investigation findings and procedural matters. These duties required strong expertise in criminal procedure law, evidence law, and prosecution decision making. This professional experience enhanced my ability to evaluate complex investigations and strengthen coordination between investigative and prosecutorial agencies.

5.1 UNDP National Consultancy Contribution (CrPC Reform and Legal Development)

In 2011, He served as National Consultant on Criminal Procedure Code (CrPC) for UNDP Bangladesh (source). Through this consultancy role, he contributed to the analysis of procedural criminal justice systems and supported reform discussions aimed at improving the criminal justice process. This experience expanded his understanding of international legal standards, justice reform methodology, and institutional policy development.

5.2 Corporate Legal Consultancy and Compliance Advisory Work

In addition to public service, He have provided legal consultancy and criminal law advisory support to major corporate entities and industrial groups, including Prothom Alo News paper, Baridhara Cosmopolitan Club SLimited, Akij Group, Amin Mohammad Group, Destiny-2000 Ltd., Hall Mark Group, Fakruddin Group, Metro Homes Development Ltd., and Mignus Group and am currently working for Summit Group as legal advisor representing Muhammed Aziz Khan who was among the top 50 richest person in Singapore in 20225 (source, source). His work included legal risk management, criminal litigation strategy, regulatory compliance support, and corporate advisory services. This private-sector experience has given his extensive exposure to compliance frameworks and corporate criminal risk prevention strategies, which are highly relevant to international legal and regulatory systems. He has also represented various prominent figures, including Shahidul Alam (photographer, journalist, and activist) in 2018 (source, source), Rozina Islam (Prothom Alo Journalist in 2021 (source, source, source), Yasir Azman (Grameen Phone CEO) in 2025 (source), and Saber Hossain Chy (former minister) in 2024 (source). He also represented journalist Shamsuzzaman Shams from Prothom Alo Newspaper who was arrested despite lawful practice of free speech and media freedom in 2022 (source).

5.3 Academic Contributions and Training of Legal Professionals

Between 2007 to 2017, He served as a part-time faculty member at Eastern University, where he teaches Trial and Advocacy (Criminal) Skills. This academic involvement reflects my commitment to workforce development and capacity building in the legal field. Through this role, he has trained law students and junior professionals in courtroom practice, criminal procedure, advocacy techniques, and trial strategy.

5.4 International Exposure, Seminars, and Professional Recognition

He has participated as a speaker and trainer in multiple national and international legal seminars and training programs, including those supported by U.S. institutions. Notable programs include:

  • ▪ Seminar on proposed Victim and Witness Protection Act, 20 March 2011 (Bangladesh National Women Lawyers’ Association)
  • ▪ Military Law Workshop on Evidence Act, 15 February 2011 (Bangladesh Army)
  • ▪ Executive Seminar on Digital Investigation, 2008 (U.S. Embassy)
  • ▪ Seminar on Criminal Investigation, 02 September 2008 (Eastern University)
  • ▪ DOJ OPDAT Roundtable Workshop on amendments to Evidence Act allowing admission of digital evidence, 17 May 2023 (U.S. Embassy, source)
  • ▪ Workshop on Bolstering Enforcement and Prosecution Networks to Combat Illicit Sanctions Evasion, accepted nomination dated 04 September 2025 (United States Office of Cooperative Threat Reduction (CTR), Bureau of International Security and Nonproliferation (ISN), supported by U.S. Embassy Dhaka, source)
  • ▪ DOJ OPDAT drafted a judicial bench book on money laundering laws of Bangladesh, and the bench book is intended for the use of judges of Bangladesh, particularly for the judges who adjudicate money laundering cases. He was appointed to review and edit the draft copy of the bench book by U.S. Embassy Dhaka on 10 December 2024 (source)
  • ▪ Invited guest for Money-Laundering Bench Book launching 13 December 2025 (U.S. Embassy)

These experiences demonstrate his active involvement in international legal development discussions and his exposure to the U.S.-supported legal capacity-building programs. He has also been approached by foreign Law farms to represent their legal issues linked to Bangladesh. For instance, Norman Spencer Law Group from NY, USA in 2024 (source) and Osborne's Law from London, UK in 2026 (source).

Dr. Borhan Uddin Khan

Distinguished Legal Expert | Professor of Law & Former Dean, University of Dhaka

Borhan enrolled himself as a lawyer with the Bangladesh Bar Council in 1986 and to the High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh in 1988. In 1989, he joined the Department of Law, University of Dhaka as a Lecturer after completing LL.B. (Hons.) and LL.M. from the same University. He is a founder member and former Vice President of the Asian Society of International Law and also the founder and current President of its Bangladesh Chapter. He also holds membership in the American Society of International Law (ASIL) and the International Law Association (ILA).

Borhan’s research interests include: International Human Rights and Humanitarian Law, International Refugee Law, International Criminal Law, International Labor Law and Minority Rights. As a Consultant of the Ministry of Law Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, he codified the laws of Bangladesh (1939-2005), published in 2007 as The Bangladesh Code (36 Volumes). He has co-authored book on, Protection of Minorities: Regimes, Norms and Issues in South Asia, (Cambridge Scholars Publishing, 2012) and co-edited Revisiting the Geneva Conventions: 1949-2019, (Brill/Nijhoff, 2020). His co-edited book on Human Rights and International Criminal Law is forthcoming in 2021.

Professor Borhan Uddin Khan received in 2017 ‘The LSE Outstanding Alumni Volunteer Award’ from his alma mater, the London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), University of London.

Barrister Milhanur Rahman

Barrister-at-Law, Lincoln’s Inn | Advocate, Supreme Court of Bangladesh

Barrister-at-Law, Lincoln’s Inn

Advocate, Supreme Court of Bangladesh

Professional Profile

His practice encompasses corporate advisory, commercial transactions, contractual documentation, criminal defence, civil litigation, financial disputes, and constitutional remedies. He advises clients on complex legal issues, develops case-specific litigation strategies, and prepares legal submissions and commercial instruments with an emphasis on accuracy, procedural compliance, and practical outcomes.

With experience in both contentious and non-contentious legal work, Barrister Milhanur provides legal services to individuals, businesses, and corporate clients, addressing their requirements through litigation, negotiation, advisory services, and alternative dispute resolution.

Areas of Practice

1. Criminal Litigation

Barrister Milhanur’s criminal litigation practice focuses on defence strategy, trial preparation, procedural remedies, evidentiary analysis, and the protection of the legal rights of accused persons. His approach involves a detailed assessment of the allegations, the evidence relied upon by the prosecution, the legality of investigative and judicial proceedings, and the availability of remedies under the applicable law.

His areas of criminal practice and related legal work include:

  • Criminal Defence and Trial Advocacy: Preparation of defence cases, analysis of prosecution evidence, cross-examination strategy, witness credibility, and legal submissions before competent criminal courts.
  • Bail and Criminal Procedure: Regular bail, anticipatory or pre-arrest bail where legally available, remand-related proceedings, discharge applications, and other remedies under the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.
  • Serious Criminal Offences: Defence-related legal work involving allegations of murder, assault, criminal intimidation, cheating, criminal breach of trust, forgery, and other offences under the Penal Code, 1860 and applicable special legislation.
  • Criminal Complaints and Magistracy Proceedings: Complaint cases, proceedings arising from police reports, cognizance, discharge, and other procedural issues before the Magistracy.
  • Appeals, Revisions and High Court Proceedings: Criminal appeals, revisions, and applications before the High Court Division or other competent courts, subject to jurisdiction and applicable procedural requirements.
  • Women and Children Repression Prevention Cases: Legal work relating to proceedings under the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act, 2000.
  • Anti-Corruption Proceedings: Legal research, defence preparation, and representation, where authorised, in matters involving the Anti-Corruption Commission and applicable anti-corruption legislation.
  • Evidence and Forensic Issues: Examination of documentary evidence, disputed signatures, forensic reports, inconsistencies in witness statements, and material defects in investigation or trial.
  • Constitutional Remedies in Criminal Matters: Legal work concerning unlawful detention, abuse of process, jurisdictional errors, and alleged violations of fundamental rights, where an appropriate remedy is maintainable.

His criminal litigation approach emphasises careful scrutiny of the prosecution case, identification of material legal and procedural defects, application of relevant statutory provisions and judicial precedents, and the protection of fair-trial rights.

2. Corporate and Commercial Law

Barrister Milhanur advises on corporate legal matters, commercial transactions, contractual obligations, regulatory compliance, and business-related disputes. His work includes legal risk assessment, contract negotiation, transactional support, corporate restructuring, and the preparation of legal documentation tailored to commercial objectives.

His corporate practice includes:

  • Corporate advisory and commercial legal consultation.
  • Company law and corporate governance.
  • Contractual risk assessment and negotiation.
  • Corporate restructuring and transactional matters.
  • Regulatory compliance and internal legal advisory.
  • Commercial dispute prevention and resolution.

3. Contract Drafting and Vetting

A significant part of his corporate practice involves drafting, reviewing, vetting, and negotiating commercial agreements. He focuses on clear contractual obligations, allocation of risk, enforceability, remedies for breach, and the protection of clients’ legal and commercial interests.

His drafting experience includes:

  • Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).
  • Service-Level Agreements and commercial service contracts.
  • Hire-Purchase Agreements.
  • Loan Facility and Syndicated Term Loan Agreements.
  • Joint Venture Agreements.
  • Memoranda and Articles of Association.
  • Settlement Agreements.
  • Project Financing Agreements.
  • Commercial and corporate instruments tailored to specific transactions.

4. Banking and Finance Litigation

Barrister Milhanur handles legal issues relating to banking documentation, loan recovery, contractual liability, guarantees, and financial disputes. His work includes analysis of loan agreements, guarantee documents, security instruments, recovery proceedings, and issues arising under the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003.

His practice includes:

  • Artha Rin suits and loan recovery proceedings.
  • Disputes involving guarantors and co-borrowers.
  • Examination of disputed loan and guarantee documentation.
  • Contractual and documentary liability disputes.
  • Legal analysis of recovery proceedings and available procedural remedies.
  • Negotiation and settlement of financial disputes.

5. Civil Litigation

His civil litigation practice includes representation and legal preparation in disputes involving contractual obligations, property and financial claims, civil liability, and other contentious matters. He focuses on pleadings, evidence, procedural compliance, interim relief, and the development of appropriate litigation strategies.

6. Debt Recovery and Negotiable Instruments Litigation

Barrister Milhanur has experience in debt recovery, settlement negotiations, and proceedings under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881. His work includes preparation of legal notices, cheque dishonour proceedings, recovery strategy, settlement discussions, and litigation relating to financial obligations.

He has reported obtaining favourable out-of-court settlements in 58 cases under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881.

7. Constitutional and Administrative Law

His legal work includes writ petitions and constitutional remedies involving questions of legality, jurisdiction, procedural fairness, administrative action, and the protection of fundamental rights. Such matters are assessed according to the applicable constitutional and statutory framework and the availability of judicial review.

8. Arbitration and Dispute Resolution

Barrister Milhanur assists clients in resolving disputes through negotiation, settlement, and arbitration. His experience includes representing clients as legal representative and assisting senior arbitrators in arbitration proceedings.

His approach prioritises effective dispute management, sound legal analysis, and commercially appropriate solutions where settlement or alternative dispute resolution is suitable.

Overview

Muhammad Easin Taha is a criminal law practitioner and Advocate of the District and Sessions Judge Court, Dhaka, with nearly four years of professional experience in criminal litigation, trial advocacy, and related legal proceedings. He is an M.Phil. Fellow in Law and a graduate of Islamic University, Bangladesh, with professional interests in complex criminal litigation, procedural law, and the jurisprudential foundations of criminal justice.

His professional practice at Shomaji & Associates involves working under the guidance of Senior Advocate Ehsanul Haque Shomaji, Head of Chambers, former Special Prosecutorial Adviser to the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of Bangladesh, with the status of Attorney General for Bangladesh. His responsibilities include case preparation, legal research, drafting complaints, plaints, appeals, revisions and petitions, preparing legal submissions, and assisting in the formulation of litigation strategies in complex criminal proceedings.

He also serves as an Associate (Part-Time) at The Law Counsel (Barrister Abdur Razzaq & Associates), working under the guidance of Barrister Ehsan A. Siddiq and Barrister Imran A. Siddiq, Senior Advocates of the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh and counsel of the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague, Netherlands. His work encompasses legal research, case analysis, and preparation relating to Death References, criminal appeals and revisions, and proceedings before or connected with the International Crimes Tribunal of Bangladesh.

Alongside his legal practice, he engages in legal writing, journalism, and public affairs. He writes columns and articles on religious, political, legal, educational, and socio-economic issues for various national newspapers and magazines, including The Daily Observer, The Daily Inqilab, Desh Rupantor, Somoyer Alo, Jugantor, The Daily Ittefaq, and The Daily Sangram. He previously served as Online News Editor at The Daily International.

Areas of practice: International Crimes; Money Laundering, Corruption and Financial Crimes; Banking Litigation and Management Disputes; Company Law, Corporate Governance and Corporate Management Disputes; Death References, Criminal Appeals and Revisions; Cybercrime and Digital Evidence; Narcotics and Drug-Related Offences; Smuggling and Customs-Related Offences; Human Trafficking and Transnational Criminal Matters; and Labour and Employment Law.

Particulars of Work Experience:

International Crimes

He has contributed to legal research, case analysis and appellate preparation in international crimes-related proceedings, working in association with Senior Advocate Barrister Imran A. Siddiq in matters before the Supreme Court of Bangladesh. These matters include Khan Akram v. International Crimes Tribunal, as well as proceedings involving Chief Prosecutor v. Sheikh Sirajul Haque alias Siraj Master & Others, Obaidul Haque Taher v. International Crimes Tribunal, Abdul Latif Talukdar v. International Crimes Tribunal and Abdul Mannan alias Monai v. International Crimes Tribunal. His work has involved research into issues of international criminal law, evidentiary standards, procedural requirements and appellate jurisprudence.

Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) Matters

He has contributed to legal research, case analysis and defence-related preparation in selected Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) matters handled by Shomaji & Associates in Bangladesh. These include proceedings concerning the Apan Jewellers gold and diamond recovery case; Hall-Mark Group Chairman Jesmin Islam; Le Méridien hotel owner Amin Ahmed; North South University Trustee Board member Md. Abul Kashem; Awami League leader Shamima Noor Papia; Salma Jesmin; Major General Abu Sayeed Masud (Retd.); BCS cadre officer Sukomal Chakma; and former government officials Shahidul Islam and Ashraful Islam. He has also contributed to defence-related work in the Destiny Tree Plantation case involving Rafiqul Amin, Managing Director; Mohammad Hossain, Chairman; and Lieutenant General Harun-ur-Rashid (Retd.), former Chairman.

Death References and Criminal Appeals

He has contributed to legal research, case analysis and appellate preparation in serious criminal proceedings, including Death Reference No. 121/2018 and Criminal Appeal No. 4110/2021, and Death Reference No. 110/2018 and Criminal Appeal No. 9512/2018, both of which resulted in acquittals. His experience also includes work relating to the PP Habibur murder case in Shariatpur, involving Mojibur Rahman Talukdar alias Lengra, and appellate matters concerning the Hazaribagh Seven Murder Case, Pallabi Six Murder Case, Jamil Akhtar Ratan murder case involving Rajshahi Medical College, and Tawfiq Hasan kidnapping and murder case in Kushtia. He is also engaged in ongoing death reference matters before the High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh. His work involves legal research, examination of trial records and evidentiary materials, and analysis of criminal procedure and appellate issues, with the nature and extent of his involvement varying according to the assignment and stage of each proceeding.

Family Law Matters

He has contributed to legal representation, case preparation and advisory work in family law proceedings involving custody, dower (denmohor), restitution of conjugal rights and other matrimonial disputes. His experience includes matters such as Barrister Tahziba Hossain, Barrister Sirajum Monir Subha v. Md. Rabiul Alam, Jesmin v. Badsha Alam, A.M. Ekramul Hasan v. Zobaida Hasan and Dr. Foysal v. Dr. Nurun Nahar. His work has involved legal research, analysis of relevant personal and statutory laws, preparation of case materials and support in proceedings before the competent family courts, according to the scope of each assignment.

Cybercrime, Narcotics, Smuggling and Human Trafficking Matters

He has contributed to legal research, case analysis and litigation preparation across a range of criminal proceedings, including digital security and cybercrime matters, narcotics prosecutions, smuggling cases and human trafficking proceedings. His experience includes Dr. Nurunnahar v. Dr. Shah Md. Faisal Iskandar, State v. Misbah Ahmed, Ohidur Rahman v. a Facebook Page Navigator Panel, State v. Choice Rahman (involving an alleged seizure of 302 kg of heroin), State v. Al Amin (Keraniganj), State v. Shahidul Islam, State v. Akter Hossain Molla, State v. Rajib, and the human trafficking matter involving Sajib Molla vs. A & A Corporation. Depending on the specific assignment, his work has involved defence-related preparation or prosecution support, legal consultation, examination of documentary and electronic evidence, statutory interpretation and analysis of procedural and evidentiary issues before the competent courts.

Labour and Employment Law Matters

He has acted as defence counsel in labour and employment-related proceedings, including Md. Moktar Ali v. Md. Nasir Uddin and Mia Md. Javed v. Excellent Sweater Ltd., involving statutory interpretation, legal analysis and consideration of amicable settlement strategies in accordance with applicable labour laws and procedures.

Md. Zahidur Rahman

Professional Experience:

1. Associate — Shomaji & Associates: Serves as an Associate at Shomaji & Associates, working under the guidance of the Head of Chambers, Senior Advocate Ehsanul Haque Shomaji. His responsibilities include case preparation, drafting complaints, plaints, appeals, revisions and petitions, legal research, preparation of legal submissions, and assisting with litigation strategy in complex criminal proceedings.

2. Defence counsel in labour and employment-related proceedings, involving statutory interpretation, legal analysis and consideration of amicable settlement strategies in accordance with applicable labour laws and procedures. He also contributes Bengali-language articles and commentaries on religious, political, legal, educational and socio-economic issues to Bangladesh.

Practice Specialties

  • Criminal Litigation & Trial Advocacy
  • Criminal Case Preparation & Legal Submissions
  • Labour & Employment Proceedings
  • Statutory Interpretation & Amicable Settlement
  • Evidentiary Analysis & Strategy

Education, Bar Admissions & Credentials

Prothom Alo-Related Cases

Shomaji & Associates represented Mr. Matiur Rahman, Editor of Prothom Alo, in criminal proceedings arising from the death of Naimul Abrar Rahat, a student of Dhaka Residential Model College, in connection with an event organised by Kishor Alo. Senior Ehsanul Haque Shomaji acted as Defence Counsel for Mr. Rahman in the proceedings before the competent court, addressing the legal issues arising from the case and advancing submissions in support of his client’s defence. The firm also represented journalist Ms. Rozina Islam in criminal proceedings arising from a case instituted against her in 2021. The representation proceedings and associated court appearances involved legal representation in distinct criminal matters concerning media professionals, with the scope of representation confined to the relevant proceedings undertaken on behalf of each client.

The Daily Star-Related Case

Shomaji & Associates represented Syed Ashfaqul Haque, former Executive Editor of The Daily Star, and his wife, Tania Khondoker, in criminal proceedings in the homicidal death. Learned Ehsanul Haque Shomaji represented as a Defence Counsel, advancing critical legal and factual arguments before the competent judicial forums.

North South University (ACC) Cases

Shomaji & Associates represent Mr. M. A. Kashem, a founding member and former Chairman of the Board of Trustees of North South University, in proceedings initiated by the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC). Senior Ehsanul Haque Shomaji represent as Defence Counsel in the relevant judicial proceedings, advancing comprehensive defenses concerning institutional decisions and legal authorization.

Grameenphone Management Dispute Cases

Shomaji & Associates represented Grameenphone Chief Executive Officer Mr. Yasir Azman, Acting Chairman of the Board of Trustees Mr. Fazlul Haque, and Chief Human Resources Officer Ms. Sayida Hossain in criminal proceedings arising from a former employee’s allegations of fraud and criminal breach of trust. The Head of Chambers, learned Ehsanul Haque Shomaji, represented as Lead Defence Counsel, demonstrating the unsubstantiated nature of the claims.

Sharif Osman Hadi Murder Case

Shomaji & Associates, through Learned Ehsanul Haque Shomaji, was involved in providing legal assistance in connection with the investigation and prosecution of the murder case concerning Sharif Osman Hadi, spokesperson of Inqilab Moncho. Advocate Shomaji was appointed by the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of Bangladesh to ensure procedural integrity and rigorous investigation guidance.

ABM Fazle Karim Chowdhury, MP Case (ICT-BD)

Shomaji & Associates represents Mr. ABM Fazle Karim Chowdhury, former Member of Parliament for Chattogram-6, in proceedings before the International Crimes Tribunal concerning allegations of crimes against humanity in connection with the July uprising 2024. The Head of Chambers, Senior Ehsanul Haque Shomaji, acts as Defence Counsel, conducting the defence during the trial proceedings and advancing legal arguments and submissions before the Tribunal in response to the allegations.

Destiny Group (ACC) Cases

Shomaji & Associates acted as Defence Counsel in the proceedings instituted by the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) in connection with allegations of financial irregularities with Destiny Group. The firm represented Mr. Rafiqul Amin, Managing Director of Destiny Group; Lieutenant General (Retd.) Harun-ur-Rashid, former Chairman; and Mr. Mohammad Hossain, Chairman, in the relevant proceedings and conducted their defence in respect of the allegations brought against them.

Hall-Mark Group (ACC) Cases

Shomaji & Associates represent Ms. Jesmin Islam, Chairman of Hall-Mark Group, as Defence Counsel in proceedings instituted by the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) concerning allegations of financial irregularities and the alleged misappropriation of loan amounts associated with Hall-Mark Group.

Actor Salman Shah Murder Case

Shomaji & Associates associated with the prosecution in the criminal proceedings concerning the death of the late Bangladeshi film actor Salman Shah. The Head of Chambers, Ehsanul Haque Shomaji, was appointed to represent prosecution, being instructed by the Metropolitan Public Prosecutor.

ভিডিও প্রেস ব্রিফিং

স্বরাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়ের বিশেষ প্রসিকিউটরিয়াল উপদেষ্টা হিসেবে দায়িত্ব নিয়ে যা বললেন এহসানুল হক সমাজী

By Daily Jugantor December 18, 2024 3,847 Views
স্বরাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়ের বিশেষ প্রসিকিউটরিয়াল উপদেষ্টা (অ্যাটর্নি জেনারেল পদমর্যাদা) হিসেবে দায়িত্ব গ্রহণের পর সাংবাদিকদের মুখোমুখি হয়ে জাতীয় প্রসিকিউশন সমন্বয় ও আইনি দায়িত্ব তুলে ধরেন এহসানুল হক সমাজী।

স্বরাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়ের বিশেষ প্রসিকিউটরিয়াল উপদেষ্টা হিসেবে নিয়োগ পাওয়ার পর সাংবাদিকদের মুখোমুখি হন বাংলাদেশ সুপ্রিম কোর্টের জ্যেষ্ঠ আইনজীবী ও সোমাজী অ্যান্ড অ্যাসোসিয়েটসের প্রধান অ্যাডভোকেট এহসানুল হক সমাজী।

তিনি জানান, রাষ্ট্রের ফৌজদারি বিচারব্যবস্থা ও প্রসিকিউশন নেটওয়ার্ককে আরো সুসংহত, নিরপেক্ষ ও স্বচ্ছ করতে তিনি সর্বোচ্চ আইনি মতামত প্রদান করবেন। পুলিশ হেডকোয়ার্টার্স, পিবিআই, ডিএমপি এবং সিআইডির তদন্ত রিপোর্ট ভেটিং ও আইনগত সমন্বয়ে এই পদ অত্যন্ত তাৎপর্যপূর্ণ ভূমিকা রাখবে।

ভিডিও প্রেস ব্রিফিং

মহানগর পাবলিক প্রসিকিউটর (পিপি) পদে যোগ দিচ্ছেন না এহসানুল হক সমাজী | Rtv News

By Rtv News August 29, 2024 4,217 Views
ঢাকা মহানগর দায়রা জজ আদালতের পাবলিক প্রসিকিউটর পদে নিয়োগের সরকারি আদেশের পর পেশাগত স্বাধীনতা অক্ষুণ্ণ রাখতে উক্ত পদে যোগদানে অপারগতা প্রকাশ করলেন অ্যাডভোকেট এহসানুল হক সমাজী।

ঢাকা মহানগর পাবলিক প্রসিকিউটর (পিপি) হিসেবে সরকারি প্রজ্ঞাপন জারির পর জ্যেষ্ঠ আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজী আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে এই পদে যোগদানে অপারগতা প্রকাশ করেন।

তিনি জানান, অতীতে ২০০৭-২০০৯ সালে তত্ত্বাবধায়ক সরকারের সময়ে তিনি এই দায়িত্ব অত্যন্ত সুনামের সাথে পালন করেছেন। বর্তমানে অসংখ্য ব্যক্তি ও করপোরেট ক্লায়েন্টের বিচারাধীন মামলায় আসামিপক্ষে আইনজীবী হিসেবে যুক্ত থাকায় স্বার্থের সংঘাত (Conflict of Interest) এড়াতে তিনি এ সিদ্ধান্ত নিয়েছেন।

আইন ও বিচার মন্ত্রণালয়ের প্রজ্ঞাপনে ঢাকা মহানগর দায়রা জজ আদালতের পাবলিক প্রসিকিউটর হিসেবে এহসানুল হক সমাজীকে দায়িত্ব প্রদান সংক্রান্ত যমুনা টিভির বিশেষ বুলেটিন।

দেশের অন্যতম শীর্ষ ফৌজদারি আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজীকে ঢাকা মহানগর দায়রা জজ আদালতের পাবলিক প্রসিকিউটর হিসেবে নিয়োগ দেওয়া সংক্রান্ত যমুনা টেলিভিশনের বিশেষ টেলিভিশন প্রতিবেদন।

প্রতিবেদনে তাঁর দীর্ঘ চার দশকের গৌরবোজ্জ্বল আইনি ক্যারিয়ার এবং বিচারিক ক্ষেত্রে উল্লেখযোগ্য অবদানের কথা বিশদভাবে তুলে ধরা হয়।

By RisingBD August 29, 2024 2,987 Views
আদালতে শুনানিতে অংশ নিয়ে রাষ্ট্রীয় গুরুত্বপূর্ণ দায়িত্বের আদেশ প্রাপ্তির বিষয়ে সিনিয়র আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজীর প্রতিক্রিয়া ও রাইজিংবিডির ভিডিও কভারেজ।

আদালতে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ মামলার শুনানি শেষে সাংবাদিকদের সাথে খোলামেলা আলোচনা করেন জ্যেষ্ঠ আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজী।

তিনি আদালত প্রাঙ্গণে আইন পেশার মর্যাদা রক্ষা এবং ন্যায়বিচার প্রতিষ্ঠায় অবিচল থাকার প্রত্যয় পুনর্ব্যক্ত করেন।

By Daily Destiny Live May 12, 2022 5,647 Views
ডেসটিনি ট্রি প্ল্যান্টেশন মামলার দীর্ঘ বিচার প্রক্রিয়া ও রায় ঘোষণার পর আসামিপক্ষের প্রধান আইনজীবী হিসেবে রায়ের আইনগত বাস্তবতা তুলে ধরে সরাসরি প্রেস ব্রিফিং।

বহু আলোচিত ডেসটিনি ট্রি প্ল্যান্টেশন মামলার রায় ঘোষণার পর গণমাধ্যমের মুখোমুখি হন প্রধান কৌঁসুলি অ্যাডভোকেট এহসানুল হক সমাজী।

তিনি রায়ের বিভিন্ন ধারা, সাজার মেয়াদ ও পরবর্তী উচ্চ আদালতে আপিল নিয়ে বিস্তারিত তুলে ধরেন এবং আইন অনুযায়ী সুবিচারের প্রত্যাশা ব্যক্ত করেন।

By Daily Destiny September 02, 2024 4,597 Views
আন্তর্জাতিক অপরাধ ট্রাইব্যুনালে বিশেষ পরামর্শক হিসেবে দায়িত্ব গ্রহণের প্রস্তাবের প্রেক্ষাপটে নিজের অবস্থান ও আইনি ব্যাখ্যা স্পষ্ট করলেন এহসানুল হক সমাজী।

By Facebook Live / Press Briefing February 14, 2025 2,862 Views

ফেসবুক ভিডিও ও প্রেস ব্রিফিং

প্রকাশনা সূত্র: Facebook Live / Press Briefing

ফেসবুকে সরাসরি দেখুন
টেলিকম খাতের শীর্ষ প্রতিষ্ঠান গ্রামীণফোনের প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা ইয়াসির আজমানের আইনি প্রতিনিধিত্ব সংক্রান্ত মামলা ও শুনানির পর গণমাধ্যমে তাৎক্ষণিক ব্রিফিং।

টেলিকম খাতের শীর্ষ প্রতিষ্ঠান গ্রামীণফোনের প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা (সিইও) ইয়াসির আজমানের আইনি প্রতিনিধিত্বে হাইকোর্টে শুনানির পর আদালতের নির্দেশনা ও আইনি প্রেক্ষাপট সম্পর্কে সাংবাদিকদের ব্রিফিং দেন জ্যেষ্ঠ আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজী।

তিনি জানান, বিচারাধীন কর্পোরেট ও টেলিকম কার্যক্রমে আইনানুগ প্রক্রিয়া অনুসরণ এবং কর্পোরেট গভর্নেন্স বজায় রাখা সংক্রান্ত বিষয়ে আদালতকে সুস্পষ্ট যুক্তি উপস্থাপন করা হয়েছে।

তদন্ত ও বিচারে প্রসিকিউশনের আইনি পরামর্শক হলেন এহসানুল হক সমাজী

By প্রথম আলো January 10, 2025 4,828 Views
চাঞ্চল্যকর মামলার সুষ্ঠু তদন্ত ও বিচারে প্রসিকিউশনকে সহায়তার জন্য সুপ্রিম কোর্টের জ্যেষ্ঠ ফৌজদারি আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজীকে বিশেষ পরামর্শক নিয়োগ করেছে সরকার।

বহুল আলোচিত ও চাঞ্চল্যকর হত্যাকাণ্ডের সুষ্ঠু তদন্ত এবং বিচারিক কার্যক্রম পরিচালনায় রাষ্ট্রপক্ষ তথা প্রসিকিউশন দলকে আইনি পরামর্শ দেওয়ার জন্য জ্যেষ্ঠ আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজীকে নিয়োগ দিয়েছে সরকার।

স্বরাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয় থেকে জারিকৃত আদেশে বলা হয়, তিনি তদন্ত কর্মকর্তার প্রতিবেদন পর্যালোচনা, সাক্ষ্য আইনের সূক্ষ্ম দিক ও উচ্চ আদালতের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী প্রসিকিউশনকে প্রয়োজনীয় দিকনির্দেশনা প্রদান করবেন।

By প্রথম আলো March 05, 2025 3,132 Views
সরকারি গুরুদায়িত্ব পালনের পাশাপাশি পূর্বে দায়েরকৃত কয়েকটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ মামলার শুনানিতে অংশ নেওয়ার অনুমতি চেয়ে সরকারকে চিঠি দিয়েছেন আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজী।

স্বরাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়ের বিশেষ প্রসিকিউটরিয়াল উপদেষ্টার দায়িত্ব পালনের পাশাপাশি ক্লায়েন্টদের পূর্বনির্ধারিত কিছু জটিল মামলায় অংশ নিতে সীমিত আকারে পেশাগত প্র্যাকটিসের সুযোগ চেয়ে সরকারকে আবেদন জানান জ্যেষ্ঠ আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজী।

চিঠিতে তিনি উল্লেখ করেন, পেশাগত সততা ও পূর্বের প্রতিশ্রুতি রক্ষার স্বার্থেই তিনি এই অনুমোদন প্রার্থনা করেছেন।

স্বরাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়ের বিশেষ প্রসিকিউটরিয়াল উপদেষ্টা হিসেবে চুক্তিভিত্তিক দায়িত্ব সফলভাবে পালনের পর সরকারের নিকট আনুষ্ঠানিক মেয়াদ সমাপ্তির চিঠি প্রেরণ করেন সুপ্রিম কোর্টের বরেণ্য আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজী।

তিনি মন্ত্রণালয়ের সকল পর্যায়ের সহযোগিতা ও আন্তরিকতার প্রতি ধন্যবাদ জ্ঞাপন করেন।

By প্রথম আলো August 27, 2024 4,197 Views
আইন, বিচার ও সংসদ বিষয়ক মন্ত্রণালয় ঢাকা মহানগর দায়রা জজ আদালতের পাবলিক প্রসিকিউটর (পিপি) হিসেবে জ্যেষ্ঠ আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজীকে নিয়োগ দিয়ে প্রজ্ঞাপন জারি করেছে।

ঢাকা মহানগর দায়রা জজ আদালতের পাবলিক প্রসিকিউটর (পিপি) হিসেবে বিশিষ্ট ফৌজদারি আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজীকে নিয়োগ সংক্রান্ত বিজ্ঞপ্তি প্রকাশ করে আইন মন্ত্রণালয়।

২০০৭-২০০৯ সালে তত্ত্বাবধায়ক সরকারের সময়েও তিনি অত্যন্ত দক্ষতার সাথে এই পদে দায়িত্ব পালন করে প্রভূত সুনাম অর্জন করেছিলেন।

Ehsanul Haque Shomaji appointed special prosecutorial adviser to Home Ministry

By Dhaka Tribune December 19, 2024 3,898 Views
Senior criminal law practitioner Ehsanul Haque Shomaji has been appointed as a special prosecutorial adviser to the Ministry of Home Affairs with the status of Attorney General for Bangladesh.

The Ministry of Home Affairs has appointed senior Supreme Court advocate Ehsanul Haque Shomaji as its Special Prosecutorial Adviser with status equivalent to the Attorney General for Bangladesh.

In this high-level role, Mr. Shomaji advises on complex criminal prosecutions, reviews police investigation files, and coordinates national prosecutorial integrity across investigating agencies.

Senior lawyer Ehsanul Haque Shomaji has formally declined the position of Public Prosecutor of Dhaka Metropolitan Sessions Court to maintain professional independence and client commitments.

ওসমান হাদির মামলায় আইনি পরামর্শক হলেন এহসানুল হক সমাজী

By NEWS24 Television January 15, 2025 3,678 Views
ইনকিলাব মঞ্চের মুখপাত্র শরীফ ওসমান হাদি হত্যা মামলার তদন্ত ও বিচারিক কার্যক্রমে রাষ্ট্রপক্ষকে সহায়তার জন্য বিশেষ প্রসিকিউটর ও আইনি পরামর্শক হিসেবে নিযুক্ত হয়েছেন অ্যাডভোকেট সমাজী।

ইনকিলাব মঞ্চের মুখপাত্র শরীফ ওসমান হাদি হত্যা মামলায় নিরপেক্ষ ও সুষ্ঠু বিচার নিশ্চিত করতে বিশিষ্ট ফৌজদারি আইন বিশেষজ্ঞ অ্যাডভোকেট এহসানুল হক সমাজীকে বিশেষ আইনি পরামর্শক নিয়োগ করেছে সরকার।

তদন্ত সংস্থার প্রস্তুতকৃত চার্জশিট পর্যালোচনা এবং আদালতে উপযুক্ত সাক্ষ্য উপস্থাপনে তিনি রাষ্ট্রপক্ষকে দিকনির্দেশনা দেবেন।

By Bangla Tribune December 19, 2024 2,947 Views
আইনশৃঙ্খলা রক্ষাকারী বাহিনীর তদন্ত রিপোর্ট পর্যালোচনা ও আইনি মতামত প্রদানে বিশেষ দক্ষতা থাকায় অ্যাডভোকেট সমাজীকে স্বরাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়ে বিশেষ কৌঁসুলি উপদেষ্টা হিসেবে নিয়োগ।

বাংলা ট্রিবিউনের প্রতিবেদনে বলা হয়, পুলিশের তদন্ত প্রতিবেদন ভেটিং ও জটিল ফৌজদারি মামলায় প্রসিকিউশনের প্রস্তুতিতে সর্বোচ্চ আইন কর্মকর্তা সমমর্যাদায় দায়িত্ব দেওয়া হয়েছে এহসানুল হক সমাজীকে।

By প্রতিদিনের বাংলাদেশ August 29, 2024 2,787 Views
পেশাগত স্বাধীনতা ও চলমান গুরুত্বপূর্ণ মামলায় আসামিপক্ষে দায়বদ্ধতার কারণে ঢাকা মহানগর পিপি পদে যোগদানে অপারগতার কথা লিখিতভাবে মন্ত্রণালয়কে জানিয়েছেন জ্যেষ্ঠ আইনজীবী সমাজী।

By The Daily Star January 20, 2025 3,918 Views
দ্য ডেইলি স্টারের নিয়মিত সংবাদ ও আর্কাইভ কাভারেজে সিনিয়র আইনজীবী এহসানুল হক সমাজীর মামলা পরিচালনা, উচ্চ আদালতের পর্যবেক্ষণ ও সাংবিধানিক রুলিংসংক্রান্ত প্রতিবেদনের সংকলন।

ইংরেজি ও বাংলা জাতীয় দৈনিক 'দ্য ডেইলি স্টার' এর স্পেশাল আর্কাইভ পেজে এহসানুল হক সমাজীর প্রতিনিধিত্বে পরিচালিত হাই-প্রোফাইল মামলার বিবরণ, বিচারিক পর্যবেক্ষণ ও বক্তব্যসমূহ নিয়মিত প্রকাশিত হয়ে আসছে।

By The Daily Observer August 28, 2024 2,567 Views
The Ministry of Law has officially appointed eminent criminal defense counsel Advocate Ehsanul Haque Shomaji as the new Metropolitan Public Prosecutor of Dhaka.

The Daily Observer reported on the appointment of Ehsanul Haque Shomaji as Metropolitan PP, citing his long track record of prosecutorial leadership during the 2007-2009 Caretaker Government regime.
